structured_output.summary: The change implements `get RegExp.prototype.dotAll` per the spec. The getter passes `this` through, uses code unit 0x0073, and calls an in-file `regexp_has_flag` helper. That helper follows RegExpHasFlag steps 1-5 in order: the non-Object TypeError, the [[OriginalFlags]] check with the SameValue(%RegExp.prototype%) → undefined branch and the TypeError otherwise, then the flags-contains check returning a Boolean. Spec step comments sit above the matching code. No test-keyed branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values, and no changes outside the one file. The helper is local to the file; sibling flag getters will likely need it too, so a later ticket may move it into support.
